calculated.reading: The fade lean in the 0.45 is not in twenty years of data: gap-ups of this size in a high-volatility market under the 200-day closed above their open 53% of the time, in both decades (51%, 55%). The last six sessions (5 of 6 gaps closed against) are a small run, not a rate. Holiday Fridays lean up and quiet; the day after a reversal day leans down but its sample is mostly 2008. Revised before the window: close above open 0.52, close above 716.70 0.70 (given a gap up, which the after-hours and the futures point to), under 0.8% 0.70 (a high-volatility full day 52-55%, a half day is about three quarters as wide and holiday Fridays 86%).
